verdict.rationale: A government tax e-services portal could plausibly offer a natural-language assistant, so the axis applies. The evidence describes only form-based eFile and Pay screens, XML and batch file specifications, and an authenticated login shell, with no chat, assistant, or natural-language command interface. The llms.txt and markdown-docs probes both returned 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
